_README: Edit freely, then run: python3 build/make_shows.py  (makes voice/shows/*.m4a, voice/shows/timings.json and the Heksa FM radio lines). Each episode: id, show (vaer|midnatt|nisse), title, unlock (first day it can air), until (last day, optional), threshold (true = only airs in Threshold World), radio (true = also on Downtown FM), lines = [[spoken text, visual cue], ...]. Optional per line: a third item as an object {"voice":"en-US-AnaNeural"} for another speaker, or {"reverse":true} to speak that line backwards. Visual cues: ident, weather, skyline, tree, sign, lamp, door, doors, map, silhouette, hill, cairns, lantern, dragon, parcel, market, flat, bowling, sled, snow, church, kids, cookies, count, static, card:TEXT. Keep spoilers out: an episode may only hint at a day's event before its unlock day.

episodes.title: Population two
episodes.summary: Tree lit, welcome sign still says population two. Opens door 1.
lines: Good evening, and welcome to Været og Nytt.
Weather: snow, minus four degrees, and a light wind from the fjord.
In the news, the Christmas tree on the square has been lit. The council describes it as, quote, mostly straight.
And the welcome sign at the edge of downtown has been repainted. It still says: population, two.
The council is checking the sign. Not the number.
That was Været og Nytt. Dress warmly. Door number one is open.

episodes.title: A hill with an opinion
episodes.summary: Kick-sleds on Hamrevegen; hints at bowling tomorrow.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: icy on the hills, with a chance of sledding.
Residents report kick-sleds on Hamrevegen again. The road has no speed limit, only a speed opinion.
Our advice: lean into the corners, and out of the way of the sheep.
Tomorrow, a very large indoor event is expected. It has pins.

episodes.title: Be kind, rewind
episodes.summary: Bowlinghallen strike on frame four; Stine and the video corner.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: cold outside, warm inside Bowlinghallen, which is where the news is tonight.
A full game of bowling was played this evening. A strike landed on frame four, and the pins have asked for a short break and a hug.
Lane seven is said to be the lucky lane. Lane eight is said to be the loud one.
The video corner is open. Tapes are due back in three days. Please rewind. Stine means it.

episodes.title: In tune, mostly
episodes.summary: Carolers by the church; if a song slows down, keep your own pace.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: clear and bitterly cold. Ideal for sound. It carries.
Singing has been heard near the church. Witnesses say the carolers were in tune, which several residents found suspicious.
Nobody has seen them arrive. Nobody has seen them leave. Several have seen them stand very still.
If a song ever slows down, the council advises you to keep your own pace, and keep humming.

episodes.title: Pockets
episodes.summary: Coins on the roads; check your pockets.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: flurries, light, with sparkles. Sparkles are not an official unit.
Coins are appearing along the roads. The bank says it has not lost any. The roads say nothing.
Collect them, say the elders, because every krone counts at Christmas. Especially the shiny ones.
Please check your pockets. Pockets are where kroner go to hide.

episodes.title: Smoke straight up
episodes.summary: Tipis at Camp Botnan; the sky was briefly too close.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: smoke rising straight up from Camp Botnan, which means a calm night.
Visitors at the tipi village report that the tipis are warm, and the sky is not. Both are true.
A guest asks whether tipis can move. The camp says tipis are exactly as mobile as you are.
In unrelated news, the night sky over the valley was for a moment slightly too close. The astronomers apologise.

episodes.title: A little lighter
episodes.summary: Notes in a mailbox; parcels arriving lighter (cookie clue).
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: grey, with a light rattling.
Rattling was reported inside an apartment building. The building says rattling is normal. Radiators exist.
Post office news. Notes have started arriving in a certain mailbox, in a mother's handwriting. Some notes are polite. Some are not from the mother.
The post office adds that parcels are arriving a little lighter than when they were sent. It is investigating. It is also hungry.

episodes.title: Deeper than it looks
episodes.summary: The ground-floor flat has stairs under it. Bring a light.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: cold, with a feeling of depth.
A ground-floor flat is deeper than it looks. Residents report that the floor has a sound under it, and the sound has stairs.
The council says floors are not usually deeper than they look. Surveyors will not be sent. Surveyors were asked, and declined.
The tenant of the flat declined to comment, loudly.
Our advice: if you go down, bring a light.

episodes.title: Globen
episodes.summary: The giant globe on the hill; do not spin it.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: clear, and very, very round.
A giant globe has been spotted out on the hill. Locals call it Globen. It has been there a long time and has not rolled once.
Geographers confirm that, from Globen, every direction is somewhere.
Visitors are asked not to spin it. Someone did, and the weather changed.

episodes.title: The long way down
episodes.summary: Orresteinen summit; the way down is the way up in reverse.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: wind on the heights, patience in the lowlands.
Climbers have reached the top of Orresteinen, the giant rock above the fjord. They report a very good view and a very long way down.
Rescue services remind everyone that the way down is also the way up, in reverse.
The rock had no comment. It never does. It is a rock.

episodes.title: Rings and one person
episodes.summary: Jetpack ring race; hints at a noisy or quiet night tomorrow.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: high, clear, and full of rings.
Air traffic downtown now consists of rings, and one person. The person is in charge of the rings. The rings disagree.
The ring race to Nonskarknuten ends at the top. Fuel runs out before ambition. This is by design.
Residents of ground-floor flats should prepare for a noisy night tomorrow. Or a very quiet one.

episodes.title: Do not go downstairs
episodes.summary: Boss day: a disturbance below; crunching is not the weather.
lines: Good evening. This bulletin is brief.
Weather: loud, with a heavy dessert warning.
A disturbance is expected in the lower levels of a certain building this evening. The council has not been told. The council would like to be told.
Residents of the ground floor are asked to stay out of the basement. Residents of the basement are asked to stay in.
If you hear crunching, that is not the weather.

episodes.title: Local witch finally quiet
episodes.summary: After the fight: Local witch finally quiet. Decorations stay up.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Local witch finally quiet. Neighbours report the first full night of sleep since the first of December. Several said they almost missed it.
The cookies, it turns out, were the problem. A mother in the south has been informed. She is not surprised.
And decorations put up at one house are staying up. This is a record.

episodes.title: A light nobody lit
episodes.summary: Lights are being lit; one came on that nobody lit.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: cold and clear. A good evening for lights.
The Christmas lights are being lit across downtown, one street at a time. Begin at the tree.
The council reminds residents that lights should be switched on by the people who switched them on. Last night one came on that nobody lit. It is a small one. It is still there.

episodes.title: All the way to the end
episodes.summary: A carol sung all the way through.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
The carolers sang a whole song tonight, all the way to the end. This is a first. Residents stood very close and did not clap, in case it stopped.
It did not stop. It was lovely.
Please stay for the whole of the next one.

episodes.title: The last parcel
episodes.summary: The last parcel arrives intact.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Post office news. The last parcel from a mother has arrived. Contents: intact. The post office says it did not open it. The post office says it looked at it a lot.
In the south, the mother is said to be, quote, a bit pleased.
Please be gentle with the cookies.

episodes.title: The hill looks back
episodes.summary: Hamrevarden hike; something counted the hiker; a hill looks back.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: sharp, bright, and visible from far away.
Hikers on Hamrevarden report that downtown looks small from up there, and that downtown knows it.
One hiker says they were counted. It felt like a very large number being said very quietly.
Hikers also noticed a hill across the valley that seemed to look back. Hills do not usually do that. Hills are being asked to stop.

episodes.title: Insert coin
episodes.summary: Arcade at Bowlinghallen; Chris vs Martin high scores.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: indoor, and a little pixelated.
At Bowlinghallen, three machines are ruling the evening: Snake, Breakout, and Sauron Invaders.
The high score table is a rivalry between a Chris and a Martin. It is cordial. The machines have asked for a referee.
The snake reports that it is very long and would like to go home.

episodes.title: A ticket for flying
episodes.summary: The Night Wing flying car gets a parking ticket.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: the usual. Clear, with a chance of flying cars.
A flying car is parked downtown. It is called the Night Wing. The parking inspector has issued a ticket for parking in a flying zone. No flying zone exists.
The ticket was accepted. The car left. The car came back. The ticket is now on the roof.

episodes.title: Be ready for quiet
episodes.summary: Wind will drop tomorrow; one warm place: it has pins.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: colder. Quieter. Be ready for quiet.
The spark race down Hamrevegen has seen a second helping of personal bests. Please do not break the sleds.
Weather experts say the wind will drop tomorrow evening. After the wind, the sound will follow.
If things feel strange tomorrow, there is one place we know will be warm. It has pins.

episodes.title: Stay warm, stay loud
episodes.summary: The Hush: lights out, red sky. Bowlinghallen stays warm.
lines: This is Været og Nytt. We are staying on air.
Weather: very quiet. The lights have gone out. The sky is the wrong colour. Please do not look at the hill.
The council wishes to say that there is a place that stays warm. Bowlinghallen is open. The lights are on. The music is loud. Come inside.
Stay together. Stay warm. Stay loud.
We will be here. Goodnight. We mean it.

episodes.title: Slightly embarrassed lights
episodes.summary: Aftermath of the Hush; coins return.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: back to normal, mostly. The sky has remembered its colour.
The lights are back on. Some of them are embarrassed.
Shops report a rush of last-minute shoppers. Coins are again appearing on the roads. The coins say sorry about last night.

episodes.title: Breathing
episodes.summary: Something breathes under a mountain; visit the church.
lines: Good evening. This is Været og Nytt.
Weather: calm, with a low rumble.
Geologists report a slow, regular movement beneath a mountain. They say it is breathing. Geologists have been asked to stop saying that.
Tomorrow is Christmas Eve. Visit the church once more tonight and say hello to everyone. Everyone is there.
Please keep the lights low and the cookies near.

episodes.title: God jul
episodes.summary: Christmas Eve sign-off to Chris and Martin.
lines: Weather: snow, minus six, and absolutely no wind.
In the news, tonight at the tree on the square, something is going to happen. The council does not know what. The council is, for once, relaxed.
Population: two. Plus everyone else who matters.
Merry Christmas, Chris and Martin. This has been Været og Nytt. Goodnight, and god jul.

episodes.title: The Doors
episodes.summary: Twenty-four doors open one by one; mind the flicker.
lines: Good evening. This is Midnatt i Sentrum. Midnight Downtown.
Tonight: a town where the doors began to open.
It started with one. A door on a quiet street that had been shut for years. One morning it stood ajar, and behind it was nothing at all. Just a little light.
The next day, another. Then a third. People stopped locking things. There seemed no point.
By the end of the month there were twenty-four doors, and each opened at its own hour, like a very patient clock.
Nobody saw who opened them. Nobody was ever late for what was behind them.
Some say a small light goes ahead of every opening, a flicker the size of a lantern. We say: mind the flicker.
This has been Midnatt i Sentrum. Close your door, if you like. It won't make any difference. God natt.

episodes.title: Quiet, Please
episodes.summary: A woman who hates noise; her flat is bigger inside than the plans allow.
lines: Good evening. This is Midnatt i Sentrum.
Tonight: a woman on the ground floor who hates noise.
She hates the radiator's knock, the neighbour's step, the boots on the stairs. She hates the singing most of all.
At first she wrote notes. Short and polite, then not polite. Then she wrote them so loudly that the paper shouted.
The neighbours began to tiptoe. Then to whisper. Then to leave.
And still the building was loud, because the loudest sound in any quiet house is the person who needs it quiet.
Her flat, they say, is larger on the inside than the plans allow. The plans were drawn by people who were never invited in.
If someone asks you to be quiet, be quiet. If they ask a third time, be somewhere else. God natt.

episodes.title: Lighter Parcels
episodes.summary: Parcels of cookies keep arriving lighter; a large appetite leaves crumbs.
lines: Good evening. This is Midnatt i Sentrum.
Tonight: a mystery from the post office.
A mother in the south bakes pepperkaker. She packs them in a tin, in a box, in brown paper, and sends them north with love and a lot of tape.
The parcel is weighed at the start. It is weighed again at the door. The scale says: seven cookies fewer. The next week, the scale says: eleven.
Crumbs were found on the stairs. The crumbs led to a window. The window led to a very large appetite, and the appetite wrote no return address.
Every week the mother asks: did you get the cookies? And every week the answer is: what cookies?
Somewhere, something is getting stronger on butter and sugar. We would call the police, but the police are also a little peckish. God natt.

episodes.title: The Eye on the Hill
episodes.summary: The old legend of the Eye on the hill, and the lantern that undoes it.
lines: Good evening. This is Midnatt i Sentrum.
Tonight: an old story from the hill above town.
The old people called it the Eye. A place where the hill looks back. They said: do not stare, it is rude. And it stares back.
It does not blink. It has been awake for a thousand winters. It has seen everything, and has never once been invited to dinner.
On some nights it opens. The town forgets how to be glad. The lights go thin. The singing goes slow.
Then somebody lights a lantern, and the town remembers.
That is the story. We checked. The hill had no comment. God natt.

episodes.title: Fifteen Cairns
episodes.summary: Fifteen dark cairns on the ridges; light them and the valley sleeps easy.
lines: Good evening. This is Midnatt i Sentrum.
On the ridges above town stand fifteen cairns. Nobody remembers building them. Everybody remembers walking past.
They say that if every cairn is lit, the valley sleeps easy. Not well. Easy.
Nobody has tried. Or somebody has, and was very quiet about it, and went home with cold hands and a good feeling.
The cairns have not been asked. A stone pile has no opinion. But if you listen on a still night, you can hear them waiting.
Light one. Then you will be one of the people who did. God natt.

episodes.title: The Market of Lights
episodes.summary: The Christmas market's lights all go out; only hand-carried lights remain.
lines: Good evening. This is Midnatt i Sentrum.
Tonight: the evening the lights went out.
The Christmas market was lovely. Stalls, waffles, the smell of cinnamon and wet wool. Hundreds of little lights on hundreds of little strings.
Then, all at once, the lights went out. Not one by one. All of them. Hundreds of people, and not one of them said a word.
In the dark, they saw the sky. It had changed colour. It was the colour of a bruise, and it was looking down.
The only lights left were the ones people carried in their hands.
This was years ago, they say. Or next week. The market keeps no calendar. God natt.

episodes.title: After the Noise
episodes.summary: The aftermath of the fight: biscuits, a clean plate, a sleeping appetite.
lines: Good evening. This is Midnatt i Sentrum.
Tonight: the quietest flat in town.
The notes have stopped. The screaming has stopped. The munching, thank goodness, has stopped.
The neighbours are returning one by one, carrying biscuits, as if apologising to a house.
A plate was found on the ground floor. It was perfectly clean. Nobody wished to ask what had been on it.
And under the floor, in a place the plans do not mention, something large and rather full is asleep.
Do not tiptoe. It is allowed to be loud again. God natt.

episodes.title: The Boy and the Lantern
episodes.summary: A boy follows a small, bossy lantern spirit through the snow.
lines: Good evening. This is Midnatt i Sentrum.
Tonight: a boy, and a lantern, and a very long night.
A boy found a lantern in the snow. It was not empty. Inside was a small, bossy light that pointed at things.
It pointed at a door. It pointed at a hill. It pointed, quite rudely, at the boy's cold feet.
He followed it, because nobody else would. It led him past the cairns and across the ice, and every time he was afraid, it got a little brighter.
Whether the light was a spirit, or a promise, or just a very good candle, the boy never asked. Some things are only polite to follow.
The lantern is still out there. Look for the flicker. God natt.

episodes.title: Under the Mountain
episodes.summary: A dragon sleeps under the mountain and dreams of warm rooms and Christmas trees.
lines: Good evening. This is Midnatt i Sentrum.
Under the mountain, something sleeps. Its breath is as slow as a long winter. The farmers do not talk about it. They only leave the sheep gates a little less open.
Geologists call it the mountain's pulse. Sheep call it grandfather. Everybody else calls it weather.
It is said to dream of gold. It is also said to dream of warm rooms, and the smell of pine needles, and a great many little lights on a tree.
It is said that on one particular night of the year it opens one eye. Just to check that everyone is still happy.
Do not wake it with carols. Wake it with a gift. God natt.

episodes.title: Counting with Pjusk
episodes.summary: Tulla and the puppet Pjusk count to 24; do not count the stars on the hill.
lines: Hei hei, friends! Welcome to Nisse-TV! I'm Tulla, and this is my friend Pjusk!
Hei hei! I live under the stairs and I eat porridge!
Today we are counting! Can you count to twenty-four? Let's count the doors!
Very good, Pjusk! Now let's count the lanterns. One little lantern, two little lanterns.
Don't count the stars on the hill, friends. The hill counts back, and it is very, very good at maths.
What is behind door number fifteen?
I'm not allowed to say! But it's warm!
Bye bye, friends! Remember to be kind to your neighbours, and to the dark!

episodes.title: Baking Day
episodes.summary: Pepperkaker baking; a tip about cookies going missing in the post.
lines: Hei hei, friends! It's baking day on Nisse-TV!
Yay! Pepperkaker! I want to eat all of them!
First, we mix butter and sugar. Then flour. Then ginger. Then a pinch of love.
Now we put them in the oven and wait. Pjusk, where is the first cookie?
It wasn't me! I was over there! With crumbs on my face!
Oh, Pjusk. Here is a tip, friends. If you send cookies in the post, count them before, and count them after.
If some are missing, don't be cross. Just ask yourself: who in the building is very, very hungry?
Bye bye, friends! Bake with a grown-up!

episodes.title: Pjusk Says Thank You
episodes.summary: After the fight, Pjusk learns to say takk for the quiet.
lines: Hei hei, friends! Today on Nisse-TV we talk about saying thank you.
Takk! Takk! Takk! That means thank you!
Sometimes a neighbour is loud, and grumpy, and a little bit scary. And sometimes that neighbour is just hungry.
Now the loud neighbour has gone quiet. Pjusk, how do you feel?
I feel full of porridge! And a little bit sorry. Takk for the quiet!
Remember, friends: a thank-you costs nothing, and it is very good with cookies.

episodes.title: The Lantern Song
episodes.summary: A hum-along lantern song: if the tune goes slow, keep your own speed.
lines: Hei hei, friends! Today on Nisse-TV: a song!
A song about the little lantern that lives in the window!
Little lantern, little light, shine for me on a winter night.
Little lantern, little spark, find me in the winter dark.
Now you try! Hum along, friends. If the tune goes slow, don't stop. Just keep going at your own speed.
Little lantern, little flame, I will say your funny name.
Bye bye, friends! Keep the light on!

episodes.title: Dragons Are Shy
episodes.summary: Dragons are shy: tiptoe at snoring, wave at a polite cough.
lines: Hei hei, friends! Today on Nisse-TV: dragons!
Are dragons scary? I don't think so!
Dragons are very shy, friends. They like warm rooms, and gold, and being left alone.
If you hear snoring from the mountain, tiptoe. If you hear a polite cough, wave.
And if a dragon asks you for a cookie, always say yes!
Always say yes. And have more cookies ready.
Bye bye, friends! Be brave, but be polite!

episodes.title: [signal lost]
episodes.summary: Threshold: weather forecast slowed and wrong, one line backwards.
lines: This is Været og Nytt. There is no weather.
Forecast: the Eye. Temperature: the wrong number. The northern lights are red tonight.
Stay indoors. Stay together. Do not look at the hill.
Do not look behind you. Do not look behind you.

episodes.title: [do not adjust your set]
episodes.summary: Threshold: the late-night show slowed down; one line backwards.
lines: Good evening. This is Midnatt i Sentrum. There is no evening here. There is only the hill.
Do not adjust your set. The set is adjusting you.
The lights have gone out. They are not coming back from here. Everyone is looking at the same place. Look at it with them.
You are not alone in this room.
God natt. God natt. God natt.

episodes.title: [pjusk is staring]
episodes.summary: Threshold: the kids' show goes slow and uncanny; one line backwards.
lines: Pjusk is staring. Pjusk will not blink.
Can you count how many are behind you? One. Two. Three. Please stop counting.
Don't be afraid, friends. The lantern is still lit.

episodes.title: Bowlinghallen Edition
episodes.summary: Cheerful Bowlinghallen news break that plays on the lounge TV.
lines: Hei hei! Welcome to Været og Nytt: Bowlinghallen edition!
Weather: warm, loud, and full of strikes.
The news: it is cosy in here, the music is good, and Stine says the popcorn is still twenty kroner.
Whatever it is like outside, in here it is warm. Everyone is welcome. Bring a friend.
Thank you for watching, and happy bowling!

episodes.title: A ninja course appears
episodes.summary: Day 3 tease: Kvinesdal has got a ninja warrior course; the organisers will not say where.
lines: This is a special report from Været og Nytt.
Kvinesdal has got its very own ninja warrior course.
It has a timer, a crowd, a pool, and according to the organisers, no refunds.
The organisers will not say where it is. We asked. They said: you will find it.
We will keep you posted. Or rather, we will keep you guessing.

episodes.title: Sources say it is enormous
episodes.summary: Day 7: reporter, sources say it is enormous; strange lights in the sky at night.
lines: Været og Nytt. More on the ninja warrior course.
Our reporter says, quote, sources say it is enormous.
How enormous? The sources held their arms wide, then wider, then sat down.
And locals report strange lights in the sky at night. Long beams, sweeping slowly, some of them blue.
The council says it is not them. We believe the council. Mostly.

episodes.title: What is going on?
episodes.summary: Day 12: vox-pops with townspeople, the prize rumour.
lines: Været og Nytt. We went out into the square and asked the people.
Olga, seventy-four, says: I saw a beam of light. It waved at me.
Sverre, thirty-one, says: it is a ninja course. I would know. I have been practising in my kitchen.
Kari, eight, says: it is a giant disco for owls.
And a rumour: the first person to find it wins a prize. Nobody knows who is giving it. Nobody knows what it is.
What is going on? We genuinely do not know.

episodes.title: Where is it?
episodes.summary: Day 17+: viewers sent photos of the lights, none of the course; where is it?
lines: Været og Nytt. Viewers have sent us four hundred photos of the lights in the sky.
Number of photos of the ninja course itself: zero.
The beams are now visible from almost every window in the valley. Dogs are confused. So are the dogs' owners.
So where is it? Nobody knows. The organisers are still not saying. We have asked four times. The fourth time, they hung up.
If you find it, tell us. Or do not. Just go. And please, mind the pool.

heksa.text: This is Heksa FM, with the real news. The other stations are lying. Num num.
Tonight's real headline: the Christmas tree is crooked. They say mostly straight. Liars.
Bowlinghallen. A very noisy game. I have filed a complaint. In triplicate. Num.
The real news about the carolers. They were seen. By me. I was holding a broom.
The post office says parcels arrive lighter. The post office should look closer to home. Num num num.
Rumour: a trapdoor. I say, do not believe rumours. I also say, do not come downstairs.
Real weather report: stay inside. Forecast: me. Chance of cookies: high.
This station is operated by a machine. The operator is currently unavailable. She is full.
Lights. So many lights. Turn them off. Turn them off. This is a recording.
The real news about the hill. The hill is looking at you. Wave. It likes it.
And now the real, real news. The sky is red. I told you. Nobody listens to the radio witch.
Something under the mountain is snoring. And for once, it is not me.
The real news. They say a ninja course has come. I say it is a trap for cookies. Num.
Real news again. The beams in the sky keep me awake. Also the beams make my cat sneeze. I want to see who is paying for the electricity. Num num.
